scope.state: Four processes, 2000 socket lifecycles each: creation, TCP_NODELAY set/get, address, SO_KEEPALIVE set/get, SO_ERROR, SO_RCVBUF set/get, close.
scope.session: Unchanged four-process complete TCP session fixture, 256 sessions each.
scope.control: Unchanged four-process basic socket/TCP_NODELAY/address/close fixture, 5000 cycles each.
scope.timing: Median of three unprofiled counterbalanced repetitions; independent diagnostic samples. Exact same static ARM64 ELF in Trames and Linux; native macOS built from same C source.
scope.native_reference: Existing ARM64 Linux-kernel Lima/VZ reference, six vCPUs/8 GiB configured. Measured and restored to stopped before Mac timings.
limitations: Socket creation/full close and bind/connect/listen/accept retain original owner ownership.
Worker SO_ERROR completion excludes namespace policy; filtered controls, virtual/DNS/guest branches and guest timeout setters retain prior boundaries.
No new quota, guest-race errno, busy-loop production bus, resource-service thread or guest-memory barriers.
Native Linux and macOS have different kernels and CPU configurations. Summed caller waits are not CPU utilization.
Socket microbenchmarks do not establish Firefox responsiveness or bulk transfer throughput.
Final additions after the measured build change test cases and documentation only; unchanged production source/binary validation was reused.
Physical iPad tests skipped per owner; iPad static cross-build passed.
